page: Microsoft Azure M832ids_16_v3 is an isolated virtual machine instance belonging to the MIDSHighMemoryv3 family. Powered by an Intel processor with x86_64 architecture, this instance features 832 dedicated virtual CPUs managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It is equipped with 15200.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 18.27 GB of RAM per core.

The instance includes 410 GB of local SSD storage and is premium storage capable, allowing for high-performance external disk attachments. It does not include any integrated graphics processing units. As an isolated instance, it provides dedicated physical hardware allocation to ensure workload isolation and minimize multi-tenant interference.

Given its massive memory footprint of over 15 terabytes and high vCPU count, the M832ids_16_v3 is designed for extremely large-scale, memory-intensive workloads. It is highly suited for massive in-memory databases, large-scale enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data warehousing operations. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the instance represents a high-density resource profile tailored for consolidated enterprise workloads that require maximum memory capacity and dedicated compute resources without GPU acceleration.
